pairs.subject: lazy-section-addressability
pairs.evidence: features/shell/AppShell.tsx:54 The application shell filters out unmounted section anchors from navigation instead of providing unconditional anchor wrappers that preserve page addressability and geometry regardless of content loading state.

techniques.evidence: features/shell/useActiveSection.ts:57 Anchor presence is determined dynamically from the rendered DOM after mount, and unrendered anchors are filtered out rather than hosted by page-level unconditional wrappers.

features/shell/navModel.test.ts:144 Tests check translation key presence in message catalogs but lack bidirectional coverage checks verifying that declared section anchors match rendered page elements.
features/shell/Sidebar.tsx:89 The public hash URL link and the internal scroll tracker active state share the same identifier string without separate namespaces or aliases.

features/shell/useActiveSection.ts:74 The scroll spy attaches an IntersectionObserver only to elements present during the initial animation frame and lacks late registration or retry logic for deferred sections.
